findings.title: Whole-pack difficulty integration assertion still expects source order
findings.trigger: Injected reverse shuffler plus StartDifficultyQuiz without a round.
findings.consequence: The PostgreSQL tagged integration test deterministically fails after every-attempt shuffling is introduced.
findings.correction: Assert a permutation/no duplicates and the injected order rather than catalog index equality; then run the affected integration test after ownership is established.

limitations: No code was edited or adopted.
This is native review evidence only; external approval, publication, and deployment remain pending.
